mapper.select: SELECT ddps.id, shares.dates, shares.pkg, shares.version, shares.user_source, shares.invitation_num, shares.fill_code_num, shares.total_user_num, ddps.create_time, ddps.update_time from (SELECT dusr.dates, dusr.pkg, dusr.version, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknow') user_source, count(DISTINCT CASE dusr.source WHEN 1 THEN dusr.user_id END) invitation_num, count(DISTINCT CASE dusr.source WHEN 2 THEN dusr.user_id END) fill_code_num, COUNT(DISTINCT dusr.user_id) total_user_num FROM dwd_user_share_record dusr left join dim_user_source dus on (dusr.parent_user_id = dus.user_id) WHERE dusr.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY dusr.dates, dusr.pkg, dusr.version, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknow')) shares LEFT JOIN dws_daily_pkg_ver_usrc_share ddps on (ddps.dates = shares.dates and ddps.pkg = shares.pkg and ddps.version = shares.version and ddps.user_source = shares.user_source)
